In-house Data Platform & AI Team in Milan running predictive analytics on CRM/customer data on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to enhance customer understanding and drive CRM campaigns (evidenced via recurring data scientist / CRM predictive analytics roles). [Google Cloud Platform (GCP)]

'ShotFlow' — a custom node-based AI workspace built by R/GA using Gemini Code Assist to lock prompts and maintain visual consistency across scenes of the Moncler brand film. [Google Gemini Code Assist (built by R/GA)]

AI-generated brand film 'From the Mountains to the City,' a ~100% AI-generated cinematic ad premiered at Google Marketing Live; R/GA used Gemini for scene ideation/descriptions, Imagen for stills, and Veo 2/3 for image-to-video generation (5-person team generated ~7,000 scenes). deployments_detail.use: AI-driven personalization and product recommendations across the Moncler digital ecosystem, tailoring content and recommendations to each visitor's interests on the relaunched site. [Google Generative AI (with R/GA)]

Moncler Genius generative-AI advertising campaign — first official AI campaign for the brand, creating 'AI exaggeration' lookbook imagery used in the worldwide press release, social media and Vogue Runway; launched at London Fashion Week. [Maison Meta (agency WeSayHi)]
